title: Studio Blocks
description: Minecraft mod created for people that use editing softwares like photoshop.
body:
Minecraft mod **created with NeoForge, for editors!** This mod adds a **plain black and green blocks.**

This mod is **great for people that uses green screens.** Because of the plain colors, its **easy to use!**

For the **best experience** with editing, **turn off smooth lightning!**
